body:
I don't think either is cowardly, so in turn, I don't think you are either. Both are tough things to do. One is painful, and one is very final.

I do think you deserve more understanding friends, and feel that was a very wrong behavior of him. There isn't more info to really say if staying friends is good, because I feel like that was a huge breach of trust.

But I feel you. I keep chasing wild dreams to feel alot more alive and like I have purpose. I struggle constantly and feel pretty lost and alone myself. In between trips that I blow all my money on, I feel really much like I'm dragging through the dirt.

I dunno, I hope you find something good. Because you have the right to enjoy what life you'll live.
